highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 3.119.3 preview improves AOT and Linux ARM64 reliability while refreshing bundled native dependencies.
highlights_body: It also carries the native binary mitigations introduced in the 3.119 servicing line.

bullets.lead: AOT and Linux ARM64 startup fixes
bullets.detail: Fixes an AOT crash when reflection is disabled and supplies Fontconfig in the Linux ARM64 cross-compile sysroot.

bullets.lead: Bundled libraries and native hardening refreshed
bullets.detail: Updates libpng, libwebp, Brotli, and libexpat while enabling additional Windows and Linux native binary mitigations.

contributor_summaries.sshumakov: Windows and Linux native binary mitigation support

preview_summaries.v3.119.3-preview.1.1: Preview 1 brought servicing fixes for AOT and Linux ARM64 together with refreshed native dependencies.
